entries.04aec734449a066a: This business provides freight transport services on consignment from customers, using trucks and other vehicles of the company and partner companies. In Japan, it is carried out by the company together with companies such as Hanshin Rojitemu Co., Ltd. and Rojitemu Transport Co., Ltd., and overseas by companies such as Rojitemu Vietnam Corporation. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,911 million.
entries.21751b2cbf655df1: A company that provides logistics services in Japan and Asia, built on truck transportation, cargo handling and distribution processing in warehouses, and cargo storage and real estate leasing.
entries.35f432375216ded1: Overseas subsidiaries such as Rojitemu Vietnam Corporation provide freight transport services in the countries and regions where they operate.
entries.4c334697f2fa3c93: Ancillary Businesses Such as Moving, Import/Export and Customs
entries.4e63a1589a369e2f: These are businesses not included in reportable segments. They include moving and relocation, construction-related, import/export cargo handling, customs clearance, port transport and worker dispatch businesses, etc., as well as merchandise sales, general leasing and overseas passenger automobile transport businesses, etc. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,697 million.
entries.5b66966e4185b736: In warehouses and distribution centers, it carries out distribution processing such as assembly, cutting and packaging, and administrative services such as order processing and inventory management.
entries.7949783aa0cadf2f: It leases real estate such as warehouses and distribution centers.
entries.9f092e5932e854c8: It carries out loading and unloading handling, such as receiving and dispatching cargo entrusted by customers in warehouses.
entries.abbaef42ed1af970: It stores cargo entrusted by customers in warehouses of its own group.
entries.ada398560f4f1883: It engages in merchandise sales and general leasing, and some overseas subsidiaries engage in passenger automobile transport businesses, among others.
entries.c7f25afe7b0e4709: It operates businesses ancillary to its three main businesses, such as moving and relocation, construction-related, import/export cargo handling, customs clearance, port transport and worker dispatch businesses.
entries.cd73f9401b5169b1: The company and its domestic consolidated subsidiaries provide freight transport services using trucks and other vehicles within Japan.
entries.d20b8c1f5c0ed75e: This business stores cargo entrusted by customers in warehouses, and also leases real estate such as warehouses and distribution centers. In Japan, it is carried out by the company together with companies such as Hanshin Rojitemu Co., Ltd. and Rojitemu International Co., Ltd., and overseas by companies such as Qianri Gufen Youxian Gongsi and Rojitemu Vietnam Corporation. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,715 million.
entries.f0ad91bfb548ef4c: This business handles loading and unloading of cargo entrusted by customers in warehouses, and also provides services such as distribution processing (assembly, cutting, packaging, etc.) and administrative services (order processing, inventory management, etc.) in the warehouses and distribution centers of the company and its customers. In Japan, it is carried out by the company together with Hanshin Rojitemu Co., Ltd. and others, and overseas by Qianri Gufen Youxian Gongsi, Rojitemu Vietnam Corporation and others. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,992 million.
